title: FC B01: National Fire Protection Association Referenced Standards
officialText:
B01.1 National Fire Protection Association standards.

The provisions of the following National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards are modified as follows:

NFPA 11-2010. The provisions of NFPA 11-2010, Low-, Medium- and High-Expansion Foam, are modified as follows:

1.Delete the language of Section 2.2 and replace with "NFPA Standards . As required by the Fire Code."

2.Delete Chapter 10 in its entirety.

NFPA 12-2011. The provisions of NFPA 12-2011, Carbon Dioxide Extinguishing Systems, are modified as follows:

1.Delete the language of Section 2.2 and replace with "NFPA Standards . As required by the Fire Code."

2.Delete Section 3.3.10.

3.Delete Section 3.3.11.1.

4.Delete Section 4.4.4.3 in its entirety.

5.Delete Sections 4.5.2(2) and 4.5.2(3).

6.In Section 4.5.4.8.2 delete "not more than 4 ft (1.2 m)" and replace with "42 to 48 inches (1067 to 1219 mm)," and add "at its center" at the end of the sentence.

7.In Section 4.5.5.5, replace "NFPA 72" with "NFPA 72, as modified by FC Appendix B."

8.Delete Section 4.6.1.1.

9.In Section 4.8.3.2(8), replace "NFPA 72" with "NFPA 72, as modified by FC Appendix B."

10.Delete Chapter 7 in its entirety.

11.Delete Chapter 8 in its entirety.

12.Delete Chapter 9 in its entirety.

NFPA 13-2016. The provisions of NFPA 13-2016, Installation of Sprinkler Systems, with respect to the design and installation of sprinkler systems, are modified to incorporate the "Modified Standards for Automatic Sprinkler, Standpipe and Fire Alarm Systems" as set forth in Appendix Q to the Building Code.

NFPA 13R-2016. The provisions of NFPA 13R-2016, Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems in Residential Occupancies up to and Including Four Stories in Height, with respect to the design and installation of sprinkler systems, are modified to incorporate the "Modified Standards for Automatic Sprinkler, Standpipe and Fire Alarm Systems" as set forth in Appendix Q to the Building Code.

NFPA 16-2015. The provisions of NFPA 16-2015, Installation of Foam-Water Sprinkler and Foam-Water Spray Systems, are modified as follows:

1.Delete the language of Section 2.2 and replace with "NFPA Standards. As required by the Fire Code."

2.Delete the language of Section 4.4.1 and replace with "A reserve supply of foam concentrate equal to that required for operation of the system for the required duration shall be available on site."

3.In Section 5.8.1, replace "NFPA 13" with "NFPA 13, as modified by FC Appendix B."

4.In Section 5.10, replace "NFPA 13" with "NFPA 13, as modified by FC Appendix B."

5.In Section 5.13.2, replace "NFPA 72" with "NFPA 72, as modified by FC Appendix B."

6.Delete items (1) through and including (10) of Section 7.3.1 and replace with "As required by this code, the Building Code and the Electrical Code, as applicable."

NFPA 17-2013. The provisions of NFPA 17-2013, Dry Chemical Extinguishing Systems, are modified as follows:

1.Delete the language of Section 2.2 and replace with "NFPA Standards. As required by the Fire Code."

2.In Section 3.2.4, replace "authority having jurisdiction" with "Fire Department."

3.Delete Section 3.4.3.

4.Delete Section 4.2 in its entirety.

5. In Section 5.7.1.7.1, replace "no more than 48 in. (1200 mm), nor less than 42 in. (1067 mm) above the floor" with "42 to 48 inches (1067 to 1219 mm) above the floor at its center."

6.In Section 5.7.4, replace "NFPA 72, National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code" with "NFPA 72, as modified by FC Appendix B" and add a new sentence to the end of the section to read "The fire extinguishing system shall report alarm and trouble signals."

7.Delete the language of Section 5.8.3.6 and replace with "The dry chemical container and expellant gas assemblies shall be located where they will be readily accessible for manual activation during an emergency, and for inspection, servicing and other maintenance."

8.Delete Chapter 8 in its entirety.

9.Delete Section 9.3 in its entirety.

10.Delete Section 9.10 in its entirety.

11.In Section 10.3, delete the language and replace with "Before any work is commenced the applicant shall submit plans to the Fire Department for approval."

12.Add a new section, 10.4.3.9, to read "The completed system shall be tested by the installer, at their own risk, as required by other provisions of the Fire Code before any approval shall be issued."

13.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 10.5, to read "A durable sign setting forth clear and concise operating instructions for the system shall be conspicuously posted at the entrance to the protected area."

NFPA 17A-2013. The provisions of NFPA 17A-2013, Wet Chemical Extinguishing Systems, are modified as follows:

1.Delete the language of Section 2.2 and replace with "NFPA Standards. As required by the Fire Code."

2.In Section 3.2.3, replace "authority having jurisdiction" with "Fire Department."

3.In Section 4.7, replace "NFPA 70, National Electrical Code" with "Electrical Code."

4.In Section 5.2.1.9, replace "NFPA 72, National Fire Alarm Code" with "NFPA 72, as modified by FC Appendix B."

5.In Section 5.2.1.10.1, replace "no more than 48 in. (1200 mm), nor less than 42 in. (1067 mm) above the floor" with "42 to 48 inches (1067 to 1219 mm) above the floor at its center."

6.In Section 6.3.5, delete the language and replace with "Before any work is commenced, the applicant shall submit plans to the Fire Department for approval."

7.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 6.4.10.4, to read "A durable sign setting forth clear and concise operating instructions for the system shall be conspicuously posted at the entrance to the protected area."

NFPA 45-2015. The provisions of NFPA 45-2015, Standard on Fire Protection for Laboratories Using Chemicals, are modified as follows:

1.In Section 1.1.1, add a new sentence to the end of the section, to read "This standard shall additionally apply to any non-production laboratory as defined in FC 202."

2.In Section 1.1.3(1)(b), delete "NFPA 54, National Fuel Gas Code" and replace with "the Fuel Gas Code".

3.In the second sentence of Section 1.1.4, insert "listed below" after the word "concentrations", and delete ", the following" and:

3.1.Insert a semicolon to the end of Sections 1.1.4(1), 1.1.4(2) and 1.1.4(3).

3.2.In Section 1.1.4(4), insert "; and" after "peroxides".

3.3.Insert a period to the end of Section 1.1.4(5).

3.4.Delete the sentence after Section 1.1.4(5).

4.Add a new Section, 1.1.7, to read "1.1.7 The provisions of this standard are adopted only with respect to operational and maintenance requirements. Pursuant to FC 102.2, operational and maintenance provisions are applicable to new and existing facilities."

5.Delete Section 1.4 in its entirety.

6.Delete Section 1.5 in its entirety.

7.Delete the language of Section 2.2 and replace with "NFPA Standards . As required by the Fire Code."

8.In Section 2.3.2, delete "ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VIII, 2013" and replace with "ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section I, II, IV, V, VI and VIII, 2010".

9.In Section 3.3.13, delete "under direct supervision of an instructor and" after the word "is".

10.In Section 3.3.31, delete "under the direct supervision of an instructor" and add a sentence to the end, to read "Laboratory units used for graduate or postgraduate research are not considered to be instructional laboratory units."

11.Delete Section 3.3.37 and replace with "3.3.37 Laboratory Unit. An enclosed space of a minimum one-hour fire-rated construction, designed or used as a non-production laboratory. Laboratory units may include one or more separate laboratory work areas, and accessory storage rooms or spaces within or contiguous with the laboratory unit, such as offices and lavatories."

12.In Section 4.2.2.1, delete "Class C or" after the word "as".

13.In Section 4.2.2.2, delete "or shall be limited to 50 percent of the flammable and combustible liquids quantity for Class C" after "Class D" and delete rest of the sentence after the word "units".

14.In Section 5.6, delete "NFPA 70" and replace with "the Electrical Code".

15.In Section 5.6.2, delete "Article 500 of NFPA 70" and replace with "the Electrical Code".

16.In Section 6.1.2, delete 6.1.2(2) and 6.1.2(3), and:

16.1.Renumber 6.1.2(4) as 6.1.2(2).

16.2.Renumber 6.1.2(5) as 6.1.2(3).

16.3.Renumber 6.1.2(6) as 6.1.2(4).

16.4.Renumber 6.1.2(7) as 6.1.2(5).

16.5.Renumber 6.1.2(8) as 6.1.2(6).

16.6.Renumber 6.1.2(9) as 6.1.2(7).

17.In Section 6.4.1, delete "where provided" and replace with "when required by the Building Code".

18.In Section 6.5.3.1:

18.1.In the section title, delete "Provisions Within the Emergency Action Plan" and replace with "Emergency Plan".

18.2.Delete the first sentence and replace with "The owner of a chemical laboratory shall cause plans for laboratory emergencies to be prepared."

18.3.In the second sentence, delete "action" between the words "emergency" and "plan".

18.4.In Section 6.5.3.1(1), insert a semicolon after "alarm".

18.5.In Section 6.5.3.1(2), delete "fire department, governmental agencies, or other emergency responders or contacts, as required" and replace with "Fire Department and other emergency response agencies;".

18.6.In Section 6.5.3.1(3), before "as applicable" insert "including primary and secondary evacuation routes," and insert a semicolon to the end of the section.

18.7.In Sections 6.5.3.1(4) and 6.5.3.1(7), insert a semicolon to the end of the section.

18.8.In Section 6.5.3.1(5), insert "regular emergency" between the words "conducting" and "drills", and insert a semicolon to the end of the section.

18.9.In Section 6.5.3.1(6), delete "shutdown" and replace with "shut down", and insert a semicolon to the end of the section.

18.10.Delete Section 6.5.3.1(8).

18.11.Renumber Section 6.5.3.1(9) as 6.5.3.1(8), and insert a semicolon to the end of the section.

18.12.Renumber Section 6.5.3.1(10) as 6.5.3.1(9), and insert "; and" to the end of the section.

18.13.Renumber Section 6.5.3.1(11) as 6.5.3.1(10), and delete "to be taken", and insert a period to the end of the section.

19.In Section 6.5.3.3, move "on the emergency plan" from the end of the sentence to between the words "trained" and "prior", and add a sentence to the end, to read "Records for such training shall be maintained in accordance with FC 107.7."

20.In Section 6.6:

20.1.In Section 6.6.2, delete "where" and replace with "by any person that uses", and delete "are used".

20.2.In Section 6.6.3, insert a comma after the word "worn", delete "where" and insert ", by any person that uses" after the word "possible", and delete "are used" after the word "reagents".

20.3.In Section 6.6.4, delete "Natural-fiber" and replace with "Any person that uses pyrophoric reagents outside the inert atmosphere of a glovebox shall wear natural-fiber", delete "shall be worn", insert "their" after the word "under", delete "the" after the word "on" and replace with "their", and delete "where pyrophoric reagents are used outside the inert atmosphere of a glovebox" after the word "feet".

21.In Section 7.2.2.1, insert "involving the handling and use of hazardous materials" after the word "operations" in the first sentence, and in the second sentence, delete "in a safe condition" and replace with "safely", delete "during the time that" and replace with "until", and delete the word "exists" and replace with "is corrected".

22.In Section 7.10.2, delete 7.10.2(2) and 7.10.2(3), and:

22.1.Renumber 7.10.2(4) as 7.10.2(2).

22.2.Renumber 7.10.2(5) as 7.10.2(3).

22.3.Renumber 7.10.2(6) as 7.10.2(4).

22.4.Renumber 7.10.2(7) as 7.10.2(5).

22.5.Renumber 7.10.2(8) as 7.10.2(6).

22.6.Renumber 7.10.2(9) as 7.10.2(7).

22.7.Renumber 7.10.2(10) as 7.10.2(8).

23.Delete Section 7.14.2 and replace with "All activities inside the hood shall be suspended immediately following the discovery of deficiencies that cause the hood to perform outside of limits established by regulatory authority requirements and/or nationally recognized industry standards".

24.In Section 8.2.3.7, delete "(SDS)" after the word "sheet".

25.In Section 8.2.4.1, delete "except as modified in Chapter 9 for buildings with more than three stories" after the word code, and delete 8.2.4.1(1) through 8.2.4.1(3).

26.In Section 8.2.4.4, delete the words "might", "(i.e., time sensitive)", and ", and properly managed".

27.In Section 8.2.4.4.1, delete "shall consist of the following elements" and replace with the word "includes", and:

27.1.In Section 8.2.4.4.1(1), insert "-" between the words "time" and "sensitive", and after the word "sensitive" insert "(materials that become hazardous during prolonged storage);".

27.2.In Section 8.2.4.4.1(2), insert a semi-colon after the word "frequency".

27.3.In Section 8.2.4.4.1(3), insert "; and" after the word "material".

27.4.In Section 8.2.4.4.1(4), insert a period after the word "results".

28.In Section 8.2.4.7, delete "shall be" and replace with "is", and add a new sentence to the end, to read "This prohibition does not apply to the storage of chemicals used in a long term experiment or research, chemicals for which special ventilation requirements are recommended based on the unusually hazardous nature of the chemicals, and any other chemical storage approved by the Fire Department."

29.In Section 8.3:

29.1.In Section 8.3.3, replace "with the hazards of the waste chemicals" with "in accordance with the regulations of the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation".

29.2.In Section 8.3.4, replace "shall not exceed 20 L (5 gal)" with "that are not required to comply with the requirements of Section 8.3.3 shall be subject to the maximum container sizes and types in accordance with Class II combustible liquids set forth in Table 9.1.2".

29.3.In Section 8.3.5, replace "Waste" with "Flammable and combustible liquid waste", and replace "type" with "types".

29.4.In Section 8.3.6, replace "subject to" with "included in".

30.In Section 9.5.1, replace "NFPA 30" with "FC 5704.3.2".

31.In Table 9.1.1(b):

31.1.In footnote b, delete "See 4.2.2 for additional requirements for educational" in front of the word "and" and replace with "Educational", and insert "shall be regulated as Class D units" after the word "laboratories".

31.2.Delete footnote d and replace with "See Exceptions 1 and 2 of FC 5006.6.1 for additional quantity restrictions on Class B Units."

31.3.Delete footnote e and replace with "See Exception 3 of FC 5006.6.1 for Class D units with 2-hour fire-rated construction."

32.In Section 11.2.7:

32.1.In the second sentence of Section 11.2.7.1(2), replace "Tubing" with "Hose/tubing", replace "clamped" with "gas-tight", and add a sentence at the end, to read "Prior to each use, all connections shall be verified for tightness.".

32.2.Add a new Section 11.2.7.1(5), to read "(5) Combustible materials shall be kept at least 0.610 m (2 ft) away from the open flame.".

33.In Section 11.2.7.2(1), insert "(0.1 pt)" after "50 ml".

34.In Section 11.3.1.1, delete ", including NFPA 70" and replace with "and the Electrical Code".

35.In Section 11.3.2.2, delete "Article 501 of NFPA 70" and replace with "the Electrical Code".

36.In Section 11.3.2.3, delete "Article 501 of NFPA 70" and replace with "the Electrical Code".

37.In Section 12.1, delete "new and existing" after the word "for", and:

37.1.Add a new section, 12.1.1, to read "12.1.1 Supervision. Educational laboratory units and instructional laboratory units shall be under the direct supervision of an instructor while the laboratory is in operation."

37.2.Add a new section, 12.1.2, to read "12.1.2 Hazard Risk Assessment. Prior to instructors performing demonstrations or students conducting experiments using hazardous chemicals, a documented hazard risk assessment shall be performed. A hazard risk assessment is a written document prepared by a qualified person, and shall include all of the following:

(1)An evaluation of the hazards of the demonstration or experiment;

(2)Appropriate personal protective equipment required;

(3)Safe work procedures;

(4)Emergency procedures; and

(5)Waste disposal procedures."

38.In Section 12.2, replace "Where" with "Whenever", and replace "required to perform a documented hazard risk assessment, provide a safety briefing to students, provide adequate personal protective equipment (PPE), and place a safety barrier (as required)" with "fully familiar with the hazard risk assessment, provide a safety briefing to students, ensure that adequate personal protective equipment has been provided and is being properly used, and ensure that safety barriers, when required by 12.3.2.1.3, are in place".

38.1.In Section 12.2.1, replace "PPE" with "personal protective equipment".

39.In Section 12.3:

39.1.In the first sentence of Section 12.3.1, replace "labs" with "laboratories", in the second sentence of such section, replace "lab classroom" with "laboratory" and replace "one day's use, preapportioned to the amount needed for each class session" with "daily use in the laboratory", and in the last sentence of such section, replace "amount of chemical that is not in use during an individual class session" with "chemicals stored in an educational laboratory" and add at the end ", except for the amounts actually in use during an individual class session".

39.2.In Section 12.3.1.1, replace "fire or building codes" with "the Fire Code and the Building Code".

39.3.In Section 12.3.1.5, replace "only when" with "while".

39.4.In Section 12.3.2.1.1, delete "primary" in front the word "means".

39.5.In Section 12.3.2.1.2, delete "being evolved" at the end of the first sentence, and delete the last sentence.

39.6.In Section 12.3.2.3, replace "In educational and instructional laboratories where experiments are conducted by students, the" with "The", replace "be responsible for conducting" with "conduct", and insert "conducted by students" between the words "experiment" and "to".

40.Delete Section 12.4 in its entirety.

41.In the first sentence of Section 13.4.2, insert "in unopened containers" after the word "storage", insert "also" between the words "shall" and "be", and delete "upon receipt and when first opened to facilitate hazard control" and replace with "when received into the laboratory chemical inventory". In the second sentence of Section 13.4.2, replace "Materials" with "Such materials", insert "managed and" before the word "disposed", insert a comma after the word "date", and delete "(SDSs) (see 8.2.4.4 and A.8.2.4.4)".

NFPA 72-2016. The provisions of NFPA 72-2016, National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code, with respect to the design and installation of fire alarm systems, are modified to incorporate the "Modified Standards for Automatic Sprinkler, Standpipe and Fire Alarm Systems" as set forth in Appendix Q to the Building Code.

NFPA 110-2013. The provisions of NFPA 110-2013, Emergency and Standby Power Systems, are modified as follows:

1.Delete Section 7.13.3.

2.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 7.13.4.1.3(5), to read "Time to initial load transfer shall not exceed 10 seconds unless a longer time is allowed by the Building Code and the Electrical Code."

3.Delete Section 7.13.4.1.3(10) and replace with "7.13.4.1.3(10) The load test with building load or other loads that simulate intended load shall continue for 2 hours observing and recording load changes and the resultant effect on voltage and frequency."

4.Delete Section 7.13.4.4.2 and replace with "7.13.4.4.2 The complete crank/rest cycle shall consist of 3-15 second crank cycles with 15 second rest periods between cranks."

5.Add a new section, 7.13.5, to read "7.13.5 Transfer switches shall be tested in accordance with 8.4.6."

6.Delete Section 8.1.2.

7.Delete Section 8.2 in its entirety.

8.Delete from the end of Section 8.3.1 the following language: "for the type and for the time duration specified for the class."

9.Delete Section 8.3.4 and replace with "8.3.4 A written record of the EPSS inspection, tests, exercising, operation, and repairs shall be maintained in accordance with FC 107.7. Records shall be inclusive of the transfer switches and storage batteries."

10.Add a new section, 8.4.4.1, to read "8.4.4.1 Inspection shall consist of observation of all EPSS components for leaks, abnormal device position and status of all alarm/trouble indicators."

11.Delete Section 8.4.5.

12. In Section 8.4.6, replace "monthly" with "semiannually."

13.In Section 8.4.6.1, replace "monthly" with "semiannually."

NFPA 130-2020. The provisions of NFPA 130-2020, Standard on Fixed Guideway Transit and Passenger Rail Systems, are modified as follows:

1.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 3.3.17, to read "If required by the Fire Department the analysis shall include the timed fire simulation, input data and output data of the computational fluid dynamics analysis."

2.Add a new section, 3.3.57.1.1, to read "3.3.57.1.1 Deep Tunnel Stations. Stations where the lowest track is 60 feet (18 288 mm) or more below grade."

3.Delete Section 4.2.1 and replace with "4.2.1 The goal of this standard shall be to provide an environment that, in the event of a fire or non-fire emergency, protects to the maximum extent practicable occupants of fixed guideway transit and passenger rail systems, including personnel present during the construction of such systems, and firefighters and other personnel responding to the fire or non-fire emergency. This goal includes the following objectives:

(1)protecting occupants not intimate with the initial fire development.

(2)maximizing the survivability of occupants intimate with the initial fire development.

(3)facilitating short term and long term firefighting operations."

4.Add a new section, 4.3.1.1, to read "4.3.1.1 Emergency responder protection. Systems shall be designed, constructed and maintained to protect emergency responders during the fire or fire-related emergencies."

5.Add a new section, 4.3.2.1, to read "4.3.2.1 Structural integrity shall be maintained to protect emergency responders during the fire or fire-related emergencies."

6.In Section 4.5, insert "by the Fire Department" at the end of the sentence.

7.Add a new section, 4.8, to read " 4.8 Terrorist protection. Rail systems shall be designed and operated to protect against potential terrorist attacks. The design and operational criteria to protect against terrorist attacks shall be approved."

8.In the first sentence of Section 5.2.1.2, insert "and in all enclosed stations and open stations greater than 10,000 square feet (929 m2 )" after the word "restricted."

9.Add a new subdivision to 5.3.2.5, to read "(8) Calculations to determine egress time shall take into consideration the impact of products of combustion, but need not take into account delays in egress caused by potential accumulations of rubbish or individuals that are not capable of self evacuation."

10.In Section 5.3.5.2, replace "1120 mm (44 in.)" with "72 inches (1829 mm)."

11.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 5.3.5.3, to read "For deep tunnel stations, an area of rescue assistance shall be provided to accommodate persons with an infirmity, disability or other special need in the course of exiting a deep tunnel station by means of a stair or escalator, as set forth in A 5.3.5.3, A5.3.5.3 (2) and the referenced literature."

12.In Section 5.3.5.4, delete the language, and replace with "Reserved".

13.Delete the introductory language in Section 5.3.5.5, and replace with: "Escalators shall not be allowed to account for more than one-half of the required means of egress capacity at any one level. Escalators shall meet the following criteria:"

14.In Section 5.3.5.5 (1), insert "being brought to a stop upon transmission of a fire alarm signal, or" between the words "of" and "being."

15.In Section 5.3.5.7(3), insert "automatically upon transmission of a fire alarm signal" between the words "stopped" and "locally," and add a new sentence after Section 5.3.5.7(3)(b), to read "Deceleration shall be in accordance with Section 5.3.5.7(4)(b)."

16.Delete the first sentence of Section 5.3.5.7(4) and replace with "Where provision is made to stop escalators counted as a means of egress, one of the following shall apply:"

17.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 5.3.5.8, to read "For deep tunnel stations, 5.3.5.3 shall apply."

18.Delete Section 5.3.6.1 and replace with "5.3.6.1 Elevators shall be installed for the possible use in the evacuation of persons with infirmities, disabilities or other special need. Elevators shall not be allowed to be used in the calculation of means of egress capacity."

19.Delete Section 5.3.6.2.

20.In Section 5.3.6.3, delete "counted as contributing to the egress capacity".

21.In Section 5.3.6.4, delete "counted as contributing to the egress capacity," delete "means of egress or" from Section 5.3.6.4(3), and add two new subdivisions to the end of Section 5.3.6.4, to read:

"(8)Elevators shall be designed to accommodate an ambulance stretcher in accordance with Section 3002.4 of the Building Code.

(9)A Fire Department-approved citywide standard key shall be provided for elevator control."

22.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 5.3.7.2, to read "Gate type exits shall have a Fire Department-approved key, for access by Fire Department personnel."

23.Add two new subdivisions to Section 5.3.10.2, to read:

"(4)Devices operable by a citywide standard key shall be installed so the door can be held in the open position.

(5)Access for emergency responders from the platform side at regular intervals by use of a citywide standard key or other approved means."

24.Delete Section 5.4.1.1 and replace with "5.4.1.1 The fire command center shall be in a separate room with hardened security features in accordance with United States Department of Homeland Security standards. The location of the fire command center shall be approved by the Fire Department."

25.Delete Section 5.4.1.2 and replace with "5.4.1.2 The fire command center shall be provided with controls for the ventilation system of the station and the tunnels serving such station."

26.Add a new section 5.4.1.3, to read "The fire command center shall be provided with voice communication capability throughout the station."

27.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 5.4.2.5, to read ", and to approved central station."

28.In Section 5.4.4.1, delete ", except trainways" at the end of the sentence. Add a new sentence to the end of Section 5.4.4.1, to read "Automatic sprinkler protection shall be provided in all areas of deep tunnel stations."

29.Delete Section 5.4.4.3 and replace with " 5.4.4.3 Sprinkler systems shall be installed and acceptance tested in accordance with the Building Code and the Fire Code. Sprinkler systems shall be approved by the Fire Department"

30.Add a new section, 5.4.4.7, to read " 5.4.4.7 A fire department connection shall be provided for all sprinkler systems, regardless of the number of sprinkler heads in such system. The design of fire department connections shall be in accordance with the Building Code and the Fire Code."

31.In Section 5.4.5.1, insert "the Building Code, the Fire Code and" between the words "with" and "NFPA 14."

32.In Section 5.4.5.2(2), replace "245 m (800 ft)" with "600 feet (182880 mm)."

33.Add a new sentence to the end of Section 5.4.5.3, to read "The location of fire department connections shall be approved by the Fire Department."

34.In Section 5.4.5.7, insert ", the Building Code and the Fire Code" at the end of the sentence.

35.Add a new section, 5.4.5.8, to read "5.4.5.8 The system shall be designed for a flow of 750 gpm (2839 L/min) (three hose streams) and with a residual pressure of not less than 100 psi (690 kPa) available at all hose outlets. Dry standpipe systems shall be capable of being completely filled with water in not more than 10 minutes at a flow rate of 750 gpm (2839 L/min)."

36.Add a new section, 5.4.5.9, to read "5.4.5.9 Standpipe hose outlets shall be installed throughout the station so that all areas within the station are within 150 feet (45 720 mm) of a hose outlet."

37.Add a new section, 5.4.5.10, to read "5.4.5.10 Standpipe systems shall be supplied by not less than two fire department connections complying with the Building Code and FC 912.
